blocks.text: will yoki going to: hammasi «qachon?» savoliga bog'liq

Ikkala shakl ham qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 26–28-darslar) va shu kitobning 20–22-darslarida alohida o'tilgan. Endi ularni yonma-yon qo'yamiz. Farqni ikki holatda ko'rish kerak: **harakat** haqida gapirganda (qaror qachon qabul qilingan?) va **bashorat** qilganda (u nimaga asoslangan?). O'zbekchada going to ko'pincha «-moqchiman», «-adigan bo'ldim» bilan, hozir qilingan qaror esa oddiy «-aman», «unda men ...» bilan beriladi.
Harakat: qaror oldin qabul qilinganmi yoki hozir?

**going to** — qaror gapirishdan **oldin** qabul qilingan: niyat bor, ehtimol tayyorgarlik ham boshlangan. **will** ('ll) — qaror aynan **gapirayotgan paytda**, vaziyatga javob sifatida tug'iladi: telefon jiringladi, kimdir yordam so'radi, muammo chiqdi. Shuning uchun taklif, va'da, «mayli, men qilaman» kabi javoblar deyarli doim will bilan aytiladi (→ 21-dars). Quyida bir xil fe'l — faqat vaziyat boshqa:

rows: The printer's out of paper. — I know, I**'m going to order** some today.
The printer's out of paper. — Is it? OK, I**'ll order** some now.
Why are you holding a brush? — I**'m going to paint** the fence.
The fence looks awful. — You're right, I**'ll paint** it on Saturday.

items.text: We've decided: **we're going to move** to Samarkand in the spring.
Oh, the bin is full. — Don't worry, **I'll empty** it.
items.translation: Voy, axlat chelagi to'lib qolibdi. — Xavotir olma, men **to'kib kelaman**.

items.text: Sorry, I can't come — **I'm going to help** my brother move house tonight.
items.translation: Kechirasiz, kela olmayman — bugun kechqurun akamga uy ko'chirishga **yordam bermoqchiman**.

blocks.text: Kelishilgan uchrashuv va reja uchun Present Continuous ham ishlatiladi (→ 19-dars): I**'m going to see** / I**'m seeing** the dentist on Monday. Farqi kichik: be -ing — boshqa odam bilan kelishilgan, aniq vaqtli reja; going to — o'z niyatim. Hozir qilinayotgan qaror uchun esa ikkalasi ham emas, faqat will.
Bashorat: belgi ko'rinib turibdimi yoki shunchaki fikrmi?

Bashoratda ham farq bor. **going to** — hozir ko'rinib turgan **belgiga, dalilga** asoslangan: osmonda qora bulut — It**'s going to rain**; yo'l to'silgan — We**'re going to be** late. Voqea go'yo allaqachon «yo'lda». **will** — shaxsiy **fikr, bilim, tajriba**ga asoslangan: I think it**'ll rain** tomorrow (hozir belgi yo'q, shunchaki shunday o'ylayman). O'zbekchada going to bashorati ko'pincha «hozir ... -adi», «-adiganga o'xshaydi» bilan beriladi.

rows: Look at those clouds — it**'s going to rain**.
I think it**'ll rain** at the weekend.
Sarah's pregnant — she**'s going to have** a baby.
4–0 with five minutes left — we**'re going to win**!
We've got a strong team; I'm sure we**'ll win**.
He's driving far too fast — he**'s going to crash**.
He's a careful driver — he**'ll be** fine.

items.text: Hurry up! The film **is going to start** in a minute.
Ask Madina — I'm sure she**'ll know** the answer.
Careful with that ladder — you**'re going to fall**!

blocks.text: Ko'p hollarda farq kichik va ikkala shakl ham to'g'ri: I think it**'ll** rain / I think it**'s going to** rain. Lekin ko'z oldingizda yuz berayotgan voqeada (stakan chetga surilib qoldi, mashina juda tez ketyapti) faqat going to tabiiy. Shart bilan esa odatda will: If you touch it, it**'ll** break.
Savolda: Are you going to ...? va Will you ...?

Savolda ham ma'no farqi bor. **Are you going to ...?** — suhbatdoshning **niyati** haqida so'raydi: Are you going to call him? — Unga qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchimisan? **Will you ...?** esa ko'pincha **iltimos**: Will you call him for me? — Men uchun unga qo'ng'iroq qilib qo'yasanmi? **Won't you ...?** — muloyim taklif: Won't you sit down? — O'tirmaysizmi?

items.text: **Are** you **going to tell** your parents about the new job?
**Will** you **post** this letter for me on your way to work?
items.translation: Ishga ketayotib bu xatni men uchun **jo'natib yuborasanmi**?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: telefon jiringlaganda «I'm going to answer it» → **I'll get it**; chipta olingan sayohat haqida «Tomorrow I will go to Samarkand» → **I'm going** to Samarkand tomorrow; osmon qorayib turganda «It will rain» → **It's going to rain**; «I'm going to going» → **I'm going to go** (to dan keyin fe'lning oddiy shakli); niyat haqida so'rash uchun «Will you go to the party?» → **Are you going to** go to the party?
Ikki savol bilan tekshiring. 1) «Bu qarorni gapirishdan oldin ham bilarmidim?» Ha → going to, yo'q → will. 2) «Bashoratimga hozir ko'rinib turgan dalil bormi?» Ha → going to, shunchaki fikr → will.

rows: I**'m going to paint** the fence.

examples.title: Deciding now: **I'll** ...
examples.description: Qaror gapirayotgan paytda, vaziyatga javob sifatida qabul qilinadi — **will** ('ll). O'zbekchada oddiy «-aman», «unda men ...».

sentences.text: It's getting cold in here, so **I'll close** the window.
sentences.translation: Bu yer sovib ketyapti, derazani **yopaman**.

sentences.text: The coffee machine is broken again? — OK, **I'll call** the technician.
sentences.translation: Qahva mashinasi yana buzildimi? — Mayli, ustaga **qo'ng'iroq qilaman**.

sentences.text: Which dessert would you like? — Hmm, **I'll have** the cheesecake, please.
sentences.translation: Qaysi shirinlikni xohlaysiz? — Mm, chizkeyk **olaman**.

sentences.text: Oh no, I've forgotten my wallet! — Don't worry, **I'll pay** for lunch today.
sentences.translation: Voy, hamyonimni unutibman! — Xavotir olma, bugun tushlikka men **to'layman**.

sentences.text: Somebody has to tell the boss about the mistake. — Fine, **I'll do** it.
sentences.translation: Kimdir boshliqqa xato haqida aytishi kerak. — Mayli, men **aytaman**.

sentences.text: There's a huge queue at the bank. — Then **we'll come** back tomorrow morning.
sentences.translation: Bankda juda uzun navbat bor. — Unda ertaga ertalab **qaytib kelamiz**.

sentences.text: This box looks heavy — **I'll help** you carry it upstairs.
sentences.translation: Bu quti og'irga o'xshaydi — yuqoriga olib chiqishga **yordam beraman**.

sentences.text: Thanks for the invitation, but I think **I'll stay** at home tonight; I'm exhausted.
sentences.translation: Taklif uchun rahmat, lekin bugun kechqurun uyda **qolaman** shekilli; juda charchadim.

sentences.text: Nobody knows the way to the new office? — Then **I'll send** everyone a map.
sentences.translation: Yangi ofisga yo'lni hech kim bilmaydimi? — Unda hammaga xarita **jo'nataman**.

sentences.text: We can't decide where to eat. — Let's try the Uzbek place; **I'll book** a table now.
sentences.translation: Qayerda ovqatlanishni hal qilolmayapmiz. — O'zbek restoranini sinab ko'raylik, hozir stol **band qilaman**.

examples.title: Decided earlier: **I'm going to** ...
examples.description: Qaror gapirishdan oldin qabul qilingan — niyat, ko'pincha tayyorgarlik ham boshlangan. O'zbekchada «-moqchiman».

sentences.text: **I'm going to paint** the bedroom this weekend — I've already bought the paint.
sentences.translation: Shu dam olish kunlari yotoqxonani **bo'yamoqchiman** — bo'yoqni allaqachon sotib oldim.

sentences.text: Jasur **is going to apply** for a master's degree in Manchester next year.
sentences.translation: Jasur kelasi yili Manchesterda magistraturaga **hujjat topshirmoqchi**.

sentences.text: Why are you wearing your gym clothes? — **I'm going to run** five kilometres before work.
sentences.translation: Nega sport kiyimini kiyib olding? — Ishdan oldin besh kilometr **yugurmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: We**'re not going to buy** a new car; we've decided to repair the old one.
sentences.translation: Yangi mashina **olmoqchi emasmiz**; eskisini ta'mirlashga qaror qildik.

sentences.text: Sarah **is going to tell** her parents about her engagement on Sunday.
sentences.translation: Sara yakshanba kuni ota-onasiga unashtirilgani haqida **aytmoqchi**.

sentences.text: What **are** you **going to do** with all those old books? — Give them to the library.
sentences.translation: Shuncha eski kitoblarni nima **qilmoqchisan**? — Kutubxonaga beraman.

sentences.text: Now that Bekzod has saved enough money, he**'s going to start** his own business.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yetarlicha pul yig'di, endi o'z biznesini **boshlamoqchi**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **going to watch** the match tonight, or have you got other plans?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun o'yinni **ko'rmoqchimisan** yoki boshqa rejang bormi?

sentences.text: Emma and James have bought some land near Oxford — they**'re going to build** a house.
sentences.translation: Emma va Jeyms Oksford yaqinidan yer sotib olishdi — uy **qurmoqchi**.

sentences.text: I've made up my mind: **I'm not going to eat** sugar for a whole month.
sentences.translation: Qat'iy qaror qildim: bir oy davomida shakar **yemayman**.

examples.title: **I'll** or **I'm going to**? Now or before
examples.description: Juft-juft: bir xil vaziyat — avval qaror oldin qabul qilingan (going to), keyin hozir qabul qilinyapti (will).

sentences.text: Did you know the car is dirty? — Yes, **I'm going to wash** it this afternoon.
sentences.translation: Mashina iflos ekanini bilasanmi? — Ha, bugun tushdan keyin **yuvmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: Your car is really dirty, you know. — Is it? Then **I'll wash** it tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Mashinang juda iflos-ku. — Shundaymi? Unda ertaga **yuvaman**.

sentences.text: Tom has invited us to his wedding. — I know, and **we're going to go**.
sentences.translation: Tom bizni to'yiga taklif qildi. — Bilaman, **bormoqchimiz**.

sentences.text: Tom has just phoned to invite us to his wedding! — How lovely! **We'll** definitely **go**.
sentences.translation: Tom hozirgina qo'ng'iroq qilib, bizni to'yiga taklif qildi! — Qanday yaxshi! Albatta **boramiz**.

sentences.text: Do you need help with the report? — No thanks, Madina **is going to check** it.
sentences.translation: Hisobotga yordam kerakmi? — Yo'q, rahmat, uni Madina **tekshiradigan bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: The report has a few mistakes. — Leave it on my desk; **I'll check** it after lunch.
sentences.translation: Hisobotda bir nechta xato bor. — Stolimga qoldiring, tushlikdan keyin **tekshiraman**.

sentences.text: Why have you bought so much flour? — **I'm going to bake** somsa for the guests.
sentences.translation: Nega shuncha ko'p un olding? — Mehmonlarga somsa **yopmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: There's no food for the guests! — Don't panic, **I'll order** some pizzas.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarga ovqat yo'q-ku! — Vahima qilma, pitsa **buyurtma qilaman**.

sentences.text: Kate has signed up for a course, because she**'s going to learn** Spanish this year.
sentences.translation: Keyt kursga yozildi, chunki bu yil ispan tilini **o'rganmoqchi**.

sentences.text: I can't understand this Spanish menu. — Give it to me, **I'll translate** it for you.
sentences.translation: Bu ispancha menyuni tushunmayapman. — Menga ber, senga **tarjima qilib beraman**.

examples.title: Predictions with evidence: **It's going to** ...
examples.description: Bashorat hozir ko'rinib turgan belgiga asoslangan: voqea go'yo allaqachon boshlangan. O'zbekchada «hozir ... -adi», «-adiganga o'xshaydi».

sentences.text: Look at those dark clouds over the hills — **it's going to rain** any minute.
sentences.translation: Tepalar ustidagi anavi qora bulutlarga qara — hozir yomg'ir **yog'ib qoladi**.

sentences.text: Careful! That glass is right on the edge of the table — **it's going to fall**.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'l! Anavi stakan stolning chetida turibdi — **tushib ketadi**.

sentences.text: Madina is pregnant, and **she's going to have** a baby in April.
sentences.translation: Madina homilador, aprelda **farzandli bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: We**'re going to miss** the train — it leaves in two minutes and we're still in the taxi.
sentences.translation: Poyezdga **ulgurmaymiz** — u ikki daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi, biz esa hali taksidamiz.

sentences.text: The score is 3–0 with five minutes left, so City **are going to win**.
sentences.translation: Hisob 3:0, besh daqiqa qoldi, demak «Siti» **yutadi**.

sentences.text: I feel awful after that fish — I think **I'm going to be** sick.
sentences.translation: O'sha baliqdan keyin o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman — **qusib yuboradiganga o'xshayman**.

sentences.text: Look at the traffic on the bridge! The meeting **is going to start** without us.
sentences.translation: Ko'prikdagi tirbandlikni qara! Uchrashuv bizsiz **boshlanib ketadi**.

sentences.text: The company has lost its biggest client, so there **are going to be** job cuts.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya eng katta mijozidan ayrildi, shuning uchun xodimlarni qisqartirish **bo'ladiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: The sky is completely clear this morning, so **it's going to be** a hot day.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab osmon tiniq, demak kun issiq **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Oliver hasn't opened a book all term, and his exam is tomorrow — **he's going to fail**.
sentences.translation: Oliver butun semestr kitob ochmadi, imtihoni esa ertaga — **yiqiladi**.

examples.title: Evidence or opinion? **going to** vs **will**
examples.description: Belgi ko'rinib turgan bashorat — going to; shaxsiy fikr, tajriba asosidagi bashorat — will. Juft-juft taqqoslash.

sentences.text: Those boys are playing football right next to the window — **they're going to break** it.
sentences.translation: Anavi bolalar derazaning yonginasida futbol o'ynashyapti — oynani **sindirishadi**.

sentences.text: Don't let the children play in the living room; I'm sure they**'ll break** something.
sentences.translation: Bolalarni mehmonxonada o'ynatmang; biror narsani **sindirishlariga aminman**.

sentences.text: I think Sarah **will be** a wonderful doctor one day — she's so patient.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, Sara bir kun ajoyib shifokor **bo'ladi** — u juda sabrli.

sentences.text: Sarah has passed her final exams, so she**'s going to be** a doctor at last!
sentences.translation: Sara bitiruv imtihonlarini topshirdi, nihoyat shifokor **bo'ladi**!

sentences.text: The road ahead is completely blocked, so we**'re going to be** late.
sentences.translation: Oldindagi yo'l butunlay to'silgan, shuning uchun **kechikamiz**.

sentences.text: Leave now, or you**'ll be** late — the traffic is always bad at this time.
sentences.translation: Hozir chiq, aks holda **kechikasan** — bu vaqtda doim tirbandlik bo'ladi.

sentences.text: In my opinion, house prices **will keep** rising for years.
sentences.translation: Fikrimcha, uy narxlari yillar davomida **oshib boraveradi**.

sentences.text: They've just announced a new tax on fuel, so prices **are going to rise** again.
sentences.translation: Hozirgina yoqilg'iga yangi soliq e'lon qilindi, demak narxlar yana **oshadi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **will** probably **love** this scarf — blue is her favourite colour.
sentences.translation: Bu ro'mol buvimga **yoqsa kerak** — ko'k uning sevimli rangi.

sentences.text: Look at Grandma's face! She**'s going to cry** when she opens the present.
sentences.translation: Buvimning yuziga qara! Sovg'ani ochganda **yig'lab yuboradi**.

examples.title: Questions: **Are you going to** ...? or **Will you** ...?
examples.description: Are you going to ...? — niyat haqida savol; Will you ...? — ko'pincha iltimos; Won't you ...? — muloyim taklif.

sentences.text: **Are** you **going to apply** for that job in Samarkand? — Yes, I've already written my CV.
sentences.translation: Samarqanddagi o'sha ishga **hujjat topshirmoqchimisan**? — Ha, rezyumeni allaqachon yozdim.

sentences.text: **Will** you **check** my CV before I send it? — Of course, give it to me.
sentences.translation: Jo'natishdan oldin rezyumemni **tekshirib berasanmi**? — Albatta, menga ber.

sentences.text: What **are** you **going to wear** to the wedding? — My new blue suit.
sentences.translation: To'yga nima **kiymoqchisan**? — Yangi ko'k kostyumimni.

sentences.text: **Will** you **lend** me your tie for the wedding? Mine is too old.
sentences.translation: To'yga galstugingni **berib turasanmi**? Meniki juda eski.

sentences.text: How **are** you **going to get** to the airport so early in the morning?
sentences.translation: Ertalab shuncha erta aeroportga qanday **bormoqchisan**?

sentences.text: Do you think your brother **will give** us a lift to the airport?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, akangiz bizni aeroportga **olib borib qo'yarmikan**?

sentences.text: **Is** Emma **going to sell** her flat in London? — Yes, she's moving to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Emma Londondagi kvartirasini **sotmoqchimi**? — Ha, Edinburgga ko'chyapti.

sentences.text: **Are** they **going to repair** the road before winter? — The council says so.
sentences.translation: Qishgacha yo'lni **ta'mirlashmoqchimi**? — Shahar kengashi shunday deyapti.

sentences.text: **Aren't** you **going to finish** your plov? — No, I'm completely full.
sentences.translation: Palovingni **tugatmaysanmi**? — Yo'q, butunlay to'ydim.

sentences.text: **Won't** you **stay** for dinner? My mother has cooked far too much.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatga **qolmaysizmi**? Oyim juda ko'p ovqat pishiribdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: a trip to Samarkand
examples.description: Aziz va Tom ta'til rejasini muhokama qiladi: oldindan qilingan reja (going to), hozir qabul qilingan qaror va fikr (will), belgi asosidagi bashorat.

sentences.text: — So, what **are** you **going to do** during the holidays, Tom?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, ta'tilda nima **qilmoqchisan**, Tom?

sentences.text: — **I'm going to visit** Samarkand — I've already booked the hotel.
sentences.translation: — Samarqandga **bormoqchiman** — mehmonxonani allaqachon band qildim.

sentences.text: — Great idea! You**'ll love** the Registan, especially at night.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r fikr! Registon senga juda **yoqadi**, ayniqsa kechasi.

sentences.text: — Why don't you come with me? It**'ll be** more fun together.
sentences.translation: — Nega men bilan bormaysan? Birga **qiziqroq bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: — Hmm, OK, why not? **I'll ask** my boss for a few days off.
sentences.translation: — Hmm, mayli, nega endi yo'q? Boshlig'imdan bir necha kun dam **so'rayman**.

sentences.text: — Brilliant! **I'll book** another room for you tonight.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! Bugun kechqurun senga ham xona **band qilaman**.

sentences.text: — Wait, look at the forecast — **it's going to be** very hot next week.
sentences.translation: — To'xta, ob-havoga qara — kelasi hafta juda **issiq bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: — Then **we'll get up** early and see the sights before lunch.
sentences.translation: — Unda erta **turamiz** va tushlikkacha diqqatga sazovor joylarni ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: — Good plan. My sister **is going to lend** me her camera, by the way.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi reja. Aytgancha, singlim menga fotoapparatini **berib turadigan bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: — Perfect. I'm sure it**'ll be** an unforgettable trip!
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Bu unutilmas sayohat **bo'lishiga aminman**!

examples.title: Mixed: work, news and everyday decisions
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: niyat, hozirgi qaror, va'da, belgi va fikr asosidagi bashorat — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: The company **is going to open** an office in Tashkent next year; the contract is already signed.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya kelasi yili Toshkentda ofis **ochmoqchi**; shartnoma allaqachon imzolangan.

sentences.text: Your laptop battery is almost dead. — Thanks, **I'll plug** it in now.
sentences.translation: Noutbuking batareyasi deyarli tugabdi. — Rahmat, hozir **zaryadga qo'yaman**.

sentences.text: Judging by the exit polls, the ruling party **is going to lose** its majority in parliament.
sentences.translation: Saylov uchastkalaridagi so'rovlarga qaraganda, hukmron partiya parlamentdagi ko'pchilikni **yo'qotadiganga o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar has finally decided: she**'s going to study** medicine in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Nilufar nihoyat qaror qildi: Buxoroda tibbiyot **o'qimoqchi**.

sentences.text: If you leave your bike outside the station, someone **will steal** it.
sentences.translation: Velosipedingni vokzal oldida qoldirsang, kimdir uni **o'g'irlab ketadi**.

sentences.text: I promise **I won't tell** anyone about your new job until you're ready.
sentences.translation: Va'da beraman, o'zing tayyor bo'lmaguningcha yangi ishing haqida hech kimga **aytmayman**.

sentences.text: Look how fast that lorry is going — **it's going to hit** the barrier!
sentences.translation: Anavi yuk mashinasi qanday tez ketyapti — to'siqqa **urilib ketadi**!

sentences.text: We've chosen the hotel, and now **we're going to look** for cheap flights.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonani tanladik, endi arzon aviachipta **qidirmoqchimiz**.

sentences.text: I don't think the new law **will change** much for ordinary people.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, yangi qonun oddiy odamlar uchun ko'p narsani **o'zgartirmaydi**.

sentences.text: James has just texted that his train is delayed, so **I'll start** the presentation without him.
sentences.translation: Jeyms hozirgina poyezdi kechikayotganini yozdi, shuning uchun taqdimotni usiz **boshlayman**.
